meta.title: Improve TTI provider reliability
meta.body_summary: Add proxy verification and retry-on-failure logic to improve reliability of TTI providers across Webscout.

perf_labels.notes: Bot-only review with non-blocking low-confidence flags; self-merged within minutes with no human interaction.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 848 changed lines across 10 files, this is a medium-sized reliability refactor. The fast, unblocked self-merge matches a low-risk infrastructure improvement with only a bot review.

review_details.concern_detail: Copilot bot flagged low-confidence issues: missing 'import json' in several provider files and duplicated upload functions; these were not blocking.
review_details.performance_claim: Improve TTI provider reliability via proxy verification and automatic retry on request failure.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Cross-cutting proxy reliability refactor across multiple provider modules; merge required no human review, relying on non-blocking bot overview, indicating low barrier for infrastructure reliability changes generated by the agent.

detection_detail.code_reading: Copilot bot reviewed all 10 files and flagged missing imports and code duplication, but these were not blocking and no human reviewer intervened.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiling, or before/after metrics; only narrative reliability improvement claim.

core_change_summary.description: Introduced a request_with_proxy_fallback utility in utils.py that fetches and validates proxies via get_auto_proxy, and integrated this fallback into all TTI provider modules for HTTP GET/POST calls. Also verified fetched proxies against a test URL in autoproxy.py.
change_trajectory: Single commit 'Improve proxy handling' implementing proxy verification, retry logic, and integration across all TTI providers.

review_signals.summary: Copilot bot provided PR overview and flagged low-confidence issues (missing json imports, duplicated upload functions) but generated no comments and did not block merge.
